extracted.name: Super Easy Cheddar Biscuits
extracted.description: Throw these together as a snack or for dinner and everyone is happy.
ingredient_lines: 4 cups baking mix (like Bisquick or Krusteez or use substitute recipe below)
1/2 cup fresh chopped dill or 2 Tbsp dried
Blend all ingredients together in food processor or use a pastry cutter
instruction_lines: Mix dry ingredients in a bowl. Add milk and oil and mix until a soft dough forms. It should be sticky. If the mixture seems dry, add more milk a little at a time.
Spoon biscuit sized balls onto cookie sheet lined with parchment, making 12 biscuits.
Place in oven and cook 11-13 minutes or until golden brown.
Repeat steps 3 and 4 for the remaining dough.
Serve warm with butter or scallion cream cheese.
